# `log_setting_change`

Area: **users** ([all tables](README.md))

Append-only audit of log_setting changes: who, the level and debug expiry before and after, and when.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Surrogate key. |
| `operator` | `text` | no |  | Username of the administrator who changed the setting. |
| `old_base_level` | `text` | yes |  | base_level before the change (null: follows LOG_LEVEL). |
| `new_base_level` | `text` | yes |  | base_level after the change. |
| `old_debug_until` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | debug_until before the change. |
| `new_debug_until` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | debug_until after the change. |
| `changed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the change was made (injected clock). |
